title: When the Spire Wakes Anew
author: Jude Galloway
blurb: Ivo Amberdale, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
